### A

```{r index-ranking}
a <- read.csv("../../data/stockData.csv", check.names = FALSE)
a$Date <- as.Date(a$Date)
a <- a[a$Date >= as.Date("2018-01-01") &
         a$Date < as.Date("2023-01-01"), ]
stocks <- setdiff(names(a), c("Date", "^GSPC"))
prices <- as.matrix(a[, c("^GSPC", stocks)])
r <- prices[-1, ] / prices[-nrow(prices), ] - 1
market <- r[, "^GSPC"]
alpha <- beta <- residual_var <- numeric(30)
for (i in seq_along(stocks)) {
  fit <- lm(r[, stocks[i]] ~ market)
  alpha[i] <- coef(fit)[1]
  beta[i] <- coef(fit)[2]
  residual_var[i] <- summary(fit)$sigma^2
}
keep <- beta > 0
stocks <- stocks[keep]
alpha <- alpha[keep]
beta <- beta[keep]
residual_var <- residual_var[keep]
mu <- alpha + beta * mean(market)
Rf <- 0.001

index_table <- data.frame(
  Stock = stocks, Alpha = alpha, Beta = beta, Mean = mu,
  Residual_var = residual_var, Ratio = (mu - Rf) / beta
)
index_table <- index_table[order(-index_table$Ratio), ]
index_table$Col1 <- with(index_table,
                         (Mean - Rf) * Beta / Residual_var)
index_table$Col2 <- cumsum(index_table$Col1)
index_table$Col3 <- with(index_table, Beta^2 / Residual_var)
index_table$Col4 <- cumsum(index_table$Col3)
index_table$Ci <- var(market) * index_table$Col2 /
  (1 + var(market) * index_table$Col4)
kable(index_table[, 1:6], digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
kable(index_table[, c(1, 7:11)], digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

### B

```{r index-portfolios}
C_short <- tail(index_table$Ci, 1)
z_short <- with(index_table,
                Beta / Residual_var * (Ratio - C_short))
w_short <- z_short / sum(z_short)
w_index_short <- w_short[match(stocks, index_table$Stock)]

index_weights <- function(rf, means) {
  ratio <- (means - rf) / beta
  o <- order(-ratio)
  Ci <- var(market) * cumsum((means[o] - rf) * beta[o] /
                              residual_var[o]) /
    (1 + var(market) * cumsum(beta[o]^2 / residual_var[o]))
  z <- beta / residual_var * pmax(ratio - max(Ci), 0)
  z / sum(z)
}
w_index_no_short <- index_weights(Rf, mu)
Sigma_index <- outer(beta, beta) * var(market) + diag(residual_var)
Sigma_hist <- cov(r[, stocks])

kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks, Short = w_index_short,
                 No_short = w_index_no_short),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
portfolios_b <- data.frame(
  Portfolio = c("Short sales allowed", "No short sales"),
  Mean = c(sum(w_index_short * mu), sum(w_index_no_short * mu)),
  SD = c(sqrt(drop(t(w_index_short) %*% Sigma_index %*%
                     w_index_short)),
         sqrt(drop(t(w_index_no_short) %*% Sigma_index %*%
                     w_index_no_short)))
)
kable(portfolios_b, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r index-plot}
frontier <- function(Sigma, model) {
  u <- solve(Sigma, mu)
  v <- solve(Sigma, rep(1, length(mu)))
  A <- sum(u)
  B <- sum(mu * u)
  C <- sum(v)
  D <- B * C - A^2
  sd_grid <- seq(sqrt(1 / C),
                 1.05 * max(sqrt(diag(cov(r)))), length.out = 500)
  data.frame(SD = sd_grid,
             Mean = A / C + sqrt((D / C) *
                                  pmax(sd_grid^2 - 1 / C, 0)),
             Model = model)
}
assets <- data.frame(Asset = colnames(r), Mean = colMeans(r),
                     SD = sqrt(diag(cov(r))))
p_base <- ggplot(assets, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Asset), vjust = -0.7, size = 2.3,
            check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Historical = "grey50",
                                "Single index" = "blue",
                                "Constant correlation" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
curves_b <- rbind(frontier(Sigma_hist, "Historical"),
                  frontier(Sigma_index, "Single index"))
p_base +
  geom_path(data = curves_b, aes(color = Model)) +
  geom_point(data = portfolios_b, aes(shape = Portfolio), size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,
                           115 * max(assets$Mean, portfolios_b$Mean)))
```

### C

```{r no-short-frontier}
Rf_grid <- c(seq(-1, -0.05, length.out = 100),
             seq(-0.05, max(mu) - 0.000001, length.out = 500))
# With equal means, the tangency portfolio minimizes variance.
w_min <- index_weights(0, rep(1, length(mu)))
no_short <- data.frame(
  Mean = sum(w_min * mu),
  SD = sqrt(drop(t(w_min) %*% Sigma_index %*% w_min))
)
for (rf in Rf_grid) {
  w <- index_weights(rf, mu)
  no_short <- rbind(no_short, data.frame(
    Mean = sum(w * mu),
    SD = sqrt(drop(t(w) %*% Sigma_index %*% w))
  ))
}
ggplot(no_short, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_path() +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### D

```{r correlation-ranking}
stock_returns <- r[, stocks]
s <- apply(stock_returns, 2, sd)
correlations <- cor(stock_returns)
rho <- mean(correlations[upper.tri(correlations)])
kable(data.frame(Rf, rho), digits = 6)

rho_table <- data.frame(Stock = stocks, Mean = mu, Excess = mu - Rf,
                        SD = s, Ratio = (mu - Rf) / s)
rho_table <- rho_table[order(-rho_table$Ratio), ]
rho_table$Col1 <- rho / (1 - rho + seq_along(stocks) * rho)
rho_table$Col2 <- cumsum(rho_table$Ratio)
rho_table$Ci <- rho_table$Col1 * rho_table$Col2
kable(rho_table, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

### E

```{r correlation-portfolios}
C_rho_short <- tail(rho_table$Ci, 1)
C_rho_no_short <- max(rho_table$Ci)
z_rho_short <- with(rho_table,
                    (Ratio - C_rho_short) / ((1 - rho) * SD))
z_rho_no_short <- with(rho_table,
                       pmax(Ratio - C_rho_no_short, 0) /
                         ((1 - rho) * SD))
w_rho_short <- z_rho_short / sum(z_rho_short)
w_rho_no_short <- z_rho_no_short / sum(z_rho_no_short)
o <- match(stocks, rho_table$Stock)
w_rho_short <- w_rho_short[o]
w_rho_no_short <- w_rho_no_short[o]
Sigma_rho <- rho * outer(s, s) + diag((1 - rho) * s^2)

kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks, Short = w_rho_short,
                 No_short = w_rho_no_short),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
portfolios_e <- data.frame(
  Portfolio = c("Short sales allowed", "No short sales"),
  Mean = c(sum(w_rho_short * mu), sum(w_rho_no_short * mu)),
  SD = c(sqrt(drop(t(w_rho_short) %*% Sigma_rho %*% w_rho_short)),
         sqrt(drop(t(w_rho_no_short) %*% Sigma_rho %*%
                     w_rho_no_short)))
)
kable(portfolios_e, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
curves_e <- rbind(frontier(Sigma_hist, "Historical"),
                  frontier(Sigma_rho, "Constant correlation"))
p_base +
  geom_path(data = curves_e, aes(color = Model)) +
  geom_point(data = portfolios_e, aes(shape = Portfolio), size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,
                           115 * max(assets$Mean, portfolios_e$Mean)))
```
